chunks.text: Dear students, welcome to GIT Smashers

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: In today's video I am going to explain Decision Tree or Decision Tree Classifier

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: If we talk about decision tree then this algorithm can be used for both classification and regression tasks

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: But mainly it is used for classification

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: And the simplest example of classification I have given earlier

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: You have an email, is that email spam or not spam?

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: In this way whenever we have to take a decision

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: Then we use the decision tree

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: I will give you one more simplest real life example

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: Let's suppose if I have to take this decision

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: I am a 4th year student, last year student of B.Tech

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: And if I have to take this decision that should I go for higher studies or not

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: Means it happens like this, it must be coming in your mind too

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: So this is a decision that should I go or not

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: So whenever we have to take such decisions then decision tree helps a lot here

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: So for example here I have taken the first attribute

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: Let's suppose placement status

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: I have taken that check placement status first

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: You will have a lot of student data

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: So you have to make a decision tree on its basis, you have to make a classifier

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: Which can classify, which can give answer that you should go for higher studies or you should not go for higher studies

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: So in our system, we give sample data first

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: And on that data which we also call training data set

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: On the basis of that data set, it becomes capable to take a decision

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: So here decision tree algorithm says that first of all you see

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: The status of care placement is whether that person is placed or not placed

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: If the person is placed then what to do in higher studies

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: You can simply say no, don't go for higher studies, join your job quietly

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: Now let's suppose not placed

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: What can you do in not placed

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: In not placed you can say that for example whether the student has given GATE exam or not

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: Has the student given GATE exam or not

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: So let's suppose if he has given GATE exam

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: And let's suppose if we talk about his score that he has qualified

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: Or you can also write high score, qualified or not qualified

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: If you have qualified then you can say that yes you should go for higher studies

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: And if you have not qualified GATE exam then we can say that no you should not go for the higher studies

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: Means in a way it is helping you to take decision that you should do this work or not

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: You can further elaborate it, this is the simplest example

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: You can also make in placement that here the value of the package, what is the package value

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: So you can say here that package is high and package is low

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: If package is high then what to do, no

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: And if package is low then you can further think that you should not go

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: So in a way it helps you somewhere that whether you should take decision or not

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: But it is not that you can make anything by taking any attribute

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: There is complete mathematics behind it, there is a complete algorithm that works properly

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: Like I will implement ID3 algorithm with all the calculations

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: So here I am just telling an introduction because this decision tree,

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: Here tree is in its name only so you know what is the concept of tree

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: We have nodes which we call vertex and edges

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: Now here first of all root node, now which will be the root node

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: I have a lot of data, there are multiple attributes in that data

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: But which root node should I choose from them

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: It is not that you can choose anyone, so as I said that there is complete mathematics behind it

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: So this splitting and selection fund is based on two things

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: One is entropy and one is your information gain

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: First of all you calculate entropy that what is the entropy of the data set

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: Then you calculate information gain and information gain and entropy

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: Which is generally based on the purity and impurity of the data

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: And if let's suppose there is a lot of impurity in the data then information gain will be less than that

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: If impurity is less, means pure data is well defined then say that information gain will be more

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: So we have to choose that attribute first whose information gain is the most

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: So I make it root node and then I further divide on its basis

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: Like for example weather, that what is weather at this time, means sunny, cloudy or rain

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: If let's suppose it is cloudy then I can say that should I play football or not

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: So I said that if it is cloudy then play, yes

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: If let's suppose it is rain then I have taken a decision that yes, there is no problem

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: But if let's suppose it is sunny then I will further check one more thing, temperature

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: So this is my decision node which is showing me like this, this is decision node

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: This is also my decision node which we represent in rectangle or sometimes in circle

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: So temperature is further hot or mild or cold

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: So if temperature is hot then say no, don't play

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: If it is mild or cold then in that case you can say that you can play

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: So this helps in taking decision and how will I know that my decision has come

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: Because your outcomes, yes or no, all of them come on leaf node

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: So you can say that your decision tree is complete

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: But again I will say that the splitting story behind this

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: That how to split decision node and how you have to calculate entropy and information gain

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: All this is pure mathematics which I will tell you in the next video

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: And this is how pruning comes

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: Basically what is the concept of pruning is that many times your tree

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: When it becomes chaos, like many edges are coming out like this

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: So we try to remove the edges unnecessarily, that is the concept of pruning

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: Rest is the same simple tree structure, vertex nodes, edges help in taking decision

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: Rest of the story is the same, if you want to ask simply then you can write

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: But in the next video I will tell you how to split all algorithms, how to calculate entropy,

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: Information gain, all mathematics in the next video

chunks.title: Introduction to Decision Tree 🌲 with Real life examples
chunks.text: Thank you
